objective.text: Select delivery channels per notifiable through via.

difficulty.rationale: Choose channels from the recipient’s delivery preference at the notification boundary.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: Every recipient needs an in-app database notification, while email is enabled only for recipients who opted in. Which notification method decides the channel list for each notifiable?

options.text: toDatabase($notifiable), returning the string "mail" for opted-in recipients.
options.rationale: The database representation is data to store, not a channel-routing instruction.
options.misconception: The database representation is data to store, not a channel-routing instruction.

options.text: A class name suffix such as OptionalMailNotification.
options.rationale: Naming a notification does not configure its delivery channels.
options.misconception: Naming a notification does not configure its delivery channels.

options.text: via($notifiable), returning database plus mail only when opted in.
options.rationale: via supplies the channels for that recipient, so it can use the notifiable’s preference.

options.text: toMail($notifiable), returning false for recipients who opted out of all channels.
options.rationale: toMail builds a mail representation; it is not the general channel-selection list and cannot remove or add database delivery this way.
options.misconception: toMail builds a mail representation; it is not the general channel-selection list and cannot remove or add database delivery this way.
